submit_reasoning: The article is a Zacks value-investing piece highlighting OI Glass as a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) with an A Value grade and low Forward P/E. I attempted to pass these as context events, but Aion's ablation gate rejected all three (they did not earn their place), so the event-informed forecast fell back to the same trajectory as the history-only run. Both runs selected the window_average model and produced identical forecasts. The series shows a gentle downtrend from ~21.78 to ~20.52 over 124 bars with low volatility (CV ~2.6%), no meaningful seasonality (strength 0.0), and 3 minor anomalies. The window_average model projects a flat 20.3418 across the 30-step horizon, which is consistent with the recent price action near the lower end of the range. I submit the history-only forecast (fc1) as the best available.
